rules: verified=true only where the row's own sourceUrl is a governing-body domain.
A value that could not be confirmed on an official domain is set to "" and flagged - never inferred.
Withdrawn prediction text is preserved on the row under k_withdrawn; nothing is deleted.
Every correction stores the official URL it was checked against and the date it was checked.

entry_type_labels.match: Match - a single head-to-head fixture with named participants

entry_type_labels.tournament: Tournament / round - an event, session or series summary, not one match
entry_type_labels.note: Note - off-season, qualification or coverage information; no fixture

fields.before: World Series Game 1 is a high-confidence pick: Milwaukee Brewers at home over Tampa Bay Rays. Milwaukee cruised to the NL's best record at 103-59 and own home-field advantage throughout the series, going 52-29 at American Family Field this season. The Brewers also swept the season series 2-0 and have the deeper bullpen ERA (3.11 vs Rays 3.89 since September). Tampa Bay are valiant AL champions at 98-64 but must open on the road after a grueling seven-game ALCS; we expect Milwaukee's ace matchup and crowd to tip Game 1 — back Brewers moneyline 1.74 and Under 7.5 with two elite staffs on extra rest.
fields.after: Back the Milwaukee Brewers to win World Series Game 1 at American Family Field on Friday night. Milwaukee won a franchise-record 103 games to lead the majors for a second straight season, then took the NLDS from the Padres in four and swept the Dodgers in the NLCS, with Jake Bauers named NLCS MVP. Tampa Bay led the American League with 98 wins and beat Cleveland in six ALCS games, but this is their first Fall Classic since 2020 and they must open on the road. The Brewers took two of three from the Rays in their only regular-season meeting. Our selection is Milwaukee on the moneyline.

Brewers hold home-field advantage and host Games 1, 2 (and 6, 7 if needed).
